label: sec:qbeta-formalize-first-gates-intro
html:
The Hoefsmit He-4 channel fixes the selector direction as a single Markov-trace collapse, T_\beta = S\cdot\mathbf{1} (prop:t-beta-markov-frobenius-collapse). This collapse leaves one object to identify: the fibre-level Habiro element F(q) whose q-Taylor coefficients provide the precision-ladder c_k of the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta series (sec:mass-algebraic-complex-volume-ladder). This section determines the structural constraints any candidate F must satisfy before evaluation. It applies formalize-first discipline to the decay side: we prove the invariants that prune the hypothesis class, then search the survivors.

Four gates prune the candidates. The generating function must possess a pole at the substrate radius (prop:q-beta-radius-of-convergence-gate). It must be bar-even under q\mapsto q^{-1} to yield a clean integer-u ladder (prop:q-beta-bar-even-kernel-invariant). It must reproduce the classical shadows c_2\to-1 and c_3\to J_{\mathrm{Hopf}}(1)=-2 at q=1 (prop:q-beta-q-eq-one-shadow-gate). It must carry a magnitude consistent with the target observable (prop:q-beta-direction-sanity-gate). These four gates bundle into one parametric typeclass (prop:q-beta-bar-even-kernel-typeclass). We assemble the mass-side analogue alongside it (prop:mass-side-kernel-formalize-first-gates).

Between the gates sits the recursion machinery. The c_k inherit a depth-d linear recursion from the Habiro q-difference kernel (prop:q-beta-c-k-recursion-from-habiro-q-difference). The bridge connects this to the per-block z-recursion (prop:qbeta-z-recursion-to-ck-recursion-bridge). Exact rational forms emerge at the silver ratio (prop:qbeta-c8-c10-silver-rationals).

The gates determine which coefficients are structural and which remain calibration-anchored. The seed c_2=-1 is Taylor-exact for the explicit-factor product (the normalised series has \tilde c_2 = -9/8). The term c_3\approx-2 is a near-match. The terms c_k for k\ge4 fit to the CODATA residual. The c_k remain cal-anchored here. We defer the categorical construction of F(q) to the brane-tower limit, where the binding \Delta_\lambda ladder lives. Any future F failing a gate is excluded without a numerical search.
